findings.title: Pre-Vote round survives leader establishment and makes the new Leader re-elect itself
findings.scenario: U3 (Pre-Vote round x running election x leader establishment)
findings.summary: With Pre-Vote enabled, a Candidate whose election timer fires calls pre_elect() and keeps its running election. If that election then wins, establish_leader() consumes only `candidate`; `pre_candidate` survives. A later granted Pre-Vote reply passes the runtime gate (same leader id) and handle_pre_vote_resp() calls elect() on the established Leader. do_elect() bumps the vote to (T+1, self, uncommitted) but keeps the Leader object at (T, committed), violating leader.committed_vote >= state.vote. RaftCore::trigger_routine_actions -> try_leader_handler then panics in debug builds (reproduced, Level 1 and Level 3); in release builds the healthy Leader runs behind its own persisted vote while campaigning for T+1.
